# Psalm 93 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** YHWH reigns; majesty he-has-clothed-himself; has-clothed-himself YHWH strength he-has-girded-himself; surely is-established the-world, not it-will-be-moved.

**2** Established your-throne from-then; from-everlasting you-are.

**3** Have-lifted the-rivers O-YHWH, have-lifted the-rivers their-voice; lift the-rivers their-crashing.

**4** More-than voices-of waters many, majestic breakers-of the-sea, majestic on-high YHWH.

**5** Your-testimonies are-very-sure; holiness befits your-house, O-YHWH, to-length-of days.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **93:1**: YHWH malakh — 'YHWH reigns/has-become-king' — opening the 'enthronement psalms' (93, 95-99).

- **93:3-4**: The threefold 'rivers' (neharot) against YHWH's supremacy — chaos waters subdued by the divine king.

— EMET
